Scenario: A message urges the technician to enter credentials at an unfamiliar sign-in link. No one has clicked yet.
A loan status changes without approval; everyone uses the same account.
The desk database is encrypted by malware; a recent isolated backup exists.
The loan portal becomes unreachable during a request flood.
A web search inserts user text directly into SQL statement text.
A note is displayed as executable content in a borrower’s browser.
A laptop with an accessible database is stolen from an unlocked room.
A new app vulnerability is disclosed; no patch is available and the exposed feature can be disabled.
